bridges.reason: A clear purpose gives an experiment direction while leaving room to change its plan.
Naming the problem a fragment could solve makes its connection to other work useful.
A collection becomes useful when preserved context helps spend finite attention, not merely accumulate more material.
Reserved, generated evidence makes dangerous or private security patterns available for bounded practice.
A local model becomes a learning instrument when its claims, stopping behavior, and evidence can be inspected.
Recording why a conclusion is supported turns model output into knowledge that can be challenged and reused.
